name: cambodia-thailand

events.event: Cambodia and Thailand began compulsory conciliation proceedings in Singapore yesterday to resolve a long-running maritime dispute.
Thailand’s Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkaew said Thailand enters this conciliation in good faith, fully mindful of the provisions of UNCLOS.
Cambodia initiated the UNCLOS process in June shortly after Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul’s government unilaterally cancelled a 2001 agreement with Cambodia governing joint offshore energy.
Singapore's government raised the annual salaries of ministers, including Prime Minister Lawrence Wong, from S$2.2 million to S$3.6 million.
Singapore's Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced he will donate his entire pay increase to charity over the next five years.
Singapore's government announced the first increase in ministerial salaries in 15 years.
Singapore's government stated that raising ministers' pay was necessary to attract better talent into public service.
Singapore's government announced that ministers will receive an initial one-off adjustment of up to 9 percent starting October 15.
Singapore's government stated that by the end of the current government's term, most junior ministers are expected to earn around S$1.35 million.
Myanmar's military-backed government accused its UN representative Kyaw Moe Tun of undertaking 'illegal activities' and misuse of state funds.
Myanmar's military-backed government announced plans to establish a formal cooperation framework with Cambodia to foster closer ties between their armed forces.
Thailand's government stated that it has evidence Cambodia stationed troops at Preah Vihear temple during border fighting.
Energy ministers and executives met in Bangkok on Monday to discuss LNG price increases triggered by the Iran war.
Singapore’s Defence Minister Chan Chun Sing visited China from Tuesday to Thursday to speak at the Beijing Xiangshan Forum.
Indonesia’s digital banks backed by major tech and telecom firms added billions in customer deposits and rapidly scaled loan portfolios over the last few years.
MariBank amassed S$1.9 billion in deposits by 2025 but posted a S$56 million loss due to tight regulatory oversight.
GSX Bank’s Malaysian arm reported total assets of $479 million as of 2025 and a loan to deposit ratio of just 25 percent.
MariBank Philippines had assets of just over $1 billion by the end of 2025, with its loan portfolio growing 64 percent year over year.
Maya Bank reported $1.25 billion in assets and saw its loan book jump 86 percent compared to 2024.

Indonesian Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa was sacked as finance minister on Monday and named his deputy Suahasil Nazara to the top finance job.
Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said he found out about his termination in a phone call with the president’s spokesman Prasetyo Hadi on Monday.
Indonesia's finance ministry plans to absorb debt payments for the Whoosh high-speed railway.
Indonesia's government restructured the Whoosh railway debt over 80 years with annual instalments of about 1 trillion rupiah.
